questions.q: What are the three numbers compared in a corporate card three-way reconciliation?
options: What the card issuer billed, what arrived in Expenses as transactions, and what has been attached to approved expense reports
The employee's salary, bonus, and tax withholding
The company's revenue, expenses, and net income
Three different currency conversion rates
questions.explain: Reconciliation compares the issuer's billed total, the transaction feed received in Expenses, and the amount actually attached to completed, approved reports.

questions.q: What does a persistent, growing gap between these three numbers most likely indicate?
options: Nothing; gaps are always meaningless and ignorable
That the company should immediately cancel all corporate cards
That the General Ledger is broken beyond repair
An operational problem with the card program worth investigating, not necessarily one bad transaction
questions.explain: A persistent gap signals a systemic issue in the program's operational health, which is why reconciliation is done as an ongoing monthly discipline rather than a one-time check.

questions.q: In the monthly reconciliation routine, why does a consultant cross-reference aged unassigned transactions against the employee-level audit list?
options: Because the two lists are always completely unrelated
Because audit lists have nothing to do with corporate cards
Because repeat unassigned-transaction offenders often overlap with repeat missing-receipt employees, reflecting the same underlying habit
Because this step is purely cosmetic and changes nothing
questions.explain: Both patterns often reflect the same employee habit of deferring documentation, so cross-referencing helps identify employees who need attention.

questions.q: How is a terminated employee's outstanding unassigned card balance typically resolved?
options: It is automatically forgiven with no further action
Through payroll offset or direct collection, following the company's offboarding policy
The General Ledger account is simply deleted
The card issuer absorbs the cost with no company involvement
questions.explain: Since a departed employee can't submit a report, the balance is resolved through payroll offset or direct collection as part of offboarding, similar to cash advance overage recovery.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what course comes next after Oracle Fusion Expenses in the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant path?
options: Oracle Fusion Order-to-Cash
SQL for Oracle Financials
Oracle Fusion Security
Oracle Fusion Procure-to-Pay
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Procure-to-Pay is the first course in the End-to-End Business Processes stage, which follows the Financial Operations stage that Expenses completes.
